messages:
jordan: FYI ACME hitting 403s from KMS during key unwrap in their Private/VPC deployment. They also report gaps in audit logs around the same time. Suspect egress/firewall or TLS proxy. Details below.

rachel: Can you paste the exact API/KMS error and the timeframe?

jordan: From our side (hosted agent logs) at 2026-03-15T11:02:13Z:
```
error: kms_unwrap_failed
cause: 403 Forbidden
kms_response: {"__type":"AccessDeniedException","message":"User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"}
x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c
```
This repeats ~every 5-10s for ~30m. Customer timeline lines up.

devon: Customer says this only occurs from their private deployment (NAT + corporate proxy + deny-by-default firewall). They said they allow *.amazonaws.com but they have an inline TLS intercept that rewrites SNI. Could be proxy causing the KMS call to be routed to the wrong backend or breaking TLS auth.

samir: Ask customer to run a few quick repro commands from their bastion (please paste outputs):
```
curl -v https://kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/  # expect 403 for unsigned calls but shows network path
openssl s_client -connect kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com:443 -servername kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
tcpdump -i eth0 host kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com and port 443 -w /tmp/kms.pcap
nslookup kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
iptables-save | sed -n '1,200p'
```

rachel: Customer ran curl and got HTTP/1.1 403 with AccessDeniedException body (same as ours). However their tcpdump shows SYN -> SYN/ACK -> RST from proxy 10.1.2.3 after TLS handshake start. They confirmed a TLS terminator that performs corporate MITM and rewrites SNI to a generic host.

jordan: If SNI gets stripped/rewritten, the downstream routing to AWS endpoints can break or hit a generic proxy cert. AWS STS/KMS signatures rely on correct host header + preserved TLS routing; weird TLS interception can cause auth or signing mismatches and return 403s. Also if the agent cannot reach our internal logging endpoint we'll see audit gaps.

devon: Two immediate hypotheses: 1) proxy is altering TLS/SNI causing KMS to reject requests, 2) outbound firewall is blocking connections to our logging endpoints so audit events never leave. Recommend using interface VPC endpoints for KMS (no internet egress) or allow transparent passthrough for specific hosts.

samir: Quick bypass test for them to run (will avoid proxy DNS / SNI rewrite if route permits):
```
# replace 52.94.76.48 with the real public IP of KMS (example only)
curl -v --resolve kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com:443:52.94.76.48 https://kms.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/
# or test AWS CLI with debug
AWS_PROFILE=acme aws kms list-keys --debug
```

rachel: Note on audit logs: agent logs show repeated `dial tcp 52.12.34.56:443: connect: connection refused` around the same timestamps. That IP corresponds to `logs.redwood-internal` in their routing. So agent couldn't forward logs.

security-bot: Automated runbook triggered: https://redwood.runbooks/kms-egress-check  | Incident created: INC-2026-042 | Severity: high

jordan: Action items: 1) Ask customer to temporarily allow egress to KMS and our logging endpoints and rerun the curl/openssl/tcpdump steps and share pcaps. 2) If they must keep TLS intercept, recommend interface VPC endpoints for KMS and S3 (avoid internet path) + allowlists for our logging FQDNs or NAT egress IPs. 3) Collect `aws --debug` output and agent logs (level=debug). Owner: devon (I'll coordinate).

devon: I'll take this. ETA 2h. Please share bastion SSH + pcap when available. I'll produce a short firewall rule set to share with their infra team (iptables and proxy config snippets).

rachel: Also flagging CS: customer saw a small billing spike due to retries/backoff while KMS calls failed; CS will coordinate credits if needed.

jordan: Thanks team — once we have pcap + aws debug we'll confirm root cause and post recommended firewall rules. :thumbsup:

k8s-deploy-bot: Deployment check: private-deploy/acme-agent v2.7.1 running on host ip-10-0-5-72, agent-heartbeat OK

jordan: Closing loop once devon posts repro and playbook.
